limitations: 1h bars cannot reproduce the runtime 5m/30m tactical features.
No historical BBO spread or aggTrade order flow is available.
Take-profit requires a confirmed close; stops trigger on the low and fill at the worse of stop and open.
Documented dataset gaps restart indicator warmup and are never bridged.
This can reject a design; it cannot prove live profitability.

rejected_by_design.reason: All slots full means price fell through every ladder level, which is the point of maximum unrealized loss. Selling there realizes the worst loss and frees capital to re-buy an asset that just demonstrated it keeps falling. Capacity must come from wider spacing or a reserved tranche, not forced capitulation.
rejected_by_design.rule: sell one or two slots when all slots are committed
